title: Cisco AI PODs - HGX Servers
description: BMC management settings for Cisco UCS HGX servers (C845A / C880A) that are configured through the BMC Redfish API instead of Intersight.

bmc_settings.title: HGX BMC Settings
bmc_settings.description:
Settings applied to every HGX BMC.  DNS, NTP, domain, and timezone default to the Initial Inventory shared services.

Required fields are:
  * `dns_servers`
  * `domain_name`
  * `ntp_servers`
  * `timezone`

Optional fields are:
  * `configure`
  * `password_ref`
  * `request_spacing`
  * `username`
  * `verify_ssl`

configure.title: Settings to Configure
configure.description: Which BMC settings the automation applies.  Every setting is applied by default.

dns.description: Default value is `true`.  Set the BMC static DNS servers.
dns.title: DNS Servers

hostname.description: Default value is `true`.  Set the BMC host name and FQDN (`<hostname>.<domain_name>`).
hostname.title: Host Name and FQDN

ntp.description: Default value is `true`.  Set the NTP servers and enable the NTP protocol.
ntp.title: NTP

timezone.description: Default value is `true`.  Set the BMC `DateTimeLocalOffset` to the current UTC offset of `timezone`.  The BMC stores an offset, not an IANA zone, so re-run after daylight saving time changes.
timezone.title: Timezone Offset

request_spacing.description: Default value is `3`.  Seconds to wait between Redfish requests; the C880A BMC rejects rapid requests.
request_spacing.title: Request Spacing (seconds)

verify_ssl.description: Default value is `false`.  Verify the BMC HTTPS certificate.  BMCs ship with self-signed certificates.
verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL

hgx_servers.title: HGX Servers
hgx_servers.description:
Cisco UCS HGX servers (C845A / C880A) managed through the BMC Redfish API.

Required fields are:
  * `bmc_settings`
  * `servers`

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: HGX servers to configure.  Pre-filled from the Initial Inventory rows with the HGX node role and the Claim Targets addresses.

password_ref.description: Default value is `HGX_BMC_PASSWORD`.  Name of the environment variable that holds the BMC password.  The web UI exports Ansible Vault key `vault_<name in lower case>` under this name; `HGX_BMC_PASSWORD` is the HGX BMC password entered on Compute > HGX Servers (a target with overridden credentials on Claim Targets uses `<HOST>_CIMC_PASSWORD`).
password_ref.title: BMC Password Reference

server.title: HGX Server
server.description:
One HGX server.

Required fields are:
  * `bmc`
  * `hostname`

Optional fields are:
  * `model`
  * `serial_number`

bmc.title: BMC
bmc.description:
BMC address and optional credential overrides.

Required fields are:
  * `ip`

Optional fields are:
  * `password_ref`
  * `username`

ip.description: BMC management address (the static address from Claim Targets when one is set).
ip.title: BMC IPv4 Address

hostname.description: Short host name set on the BMC; the FQDN is `<hostname>.<domain_name>`.
hostname.title: Host Name

serial_number.description: Server serial number from the Initial Inventory.
serial_number.title: Serial Number

username.description: Default value is `admin`.  BMC user name.
username.title: BMC Username
